description.ncbi_summary: Predicted to enable transmembrane signaling receptor activity. Predicted to be involved in several processes, including cell-cell adhesion via plasma-membrane adhesion molecules; mast cell degranulation; and negative regulation of mast cell activation. Predicted to be integral component of plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Apr 2022]

uniprot_function.text: Immunoglobulin-like receptor which plays an inhibitory role in degranulation of mast cells. Negatively regulates IgE-mediated mast cell activation and suppresses the type I immediate hypersensitivity reaction (By similarity).
